title: Dynamic Island metaball capsule
blurb: A WebGL 2 smooth-union (smin) Dynamic Island capsule that morphs between a compact pill, a split twin bubble with a draggable orb, a media player and a timer with an incoming call while compositing crisp live HTML controls after the liquid necking pass.
question: Can a WebGL smooth-union (smin) metaball capsule morph cleanly between compact pills, split twin bubbles and expanded widgets while compositing crisp live HTML buttons, sliders and timers after the liquid necking pass so typography never blurs?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27): 4/4 live checks pass (0.97 MP, 7.8 MB at 412 px DPR 2.625); setting UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL = true on ElementGL fixes translucent dark-glass UI uploads so texElementSubImage2D() blends cleanly instead of turning solid white. Real Android hardware stays not verified.
